lines.text: Sometimes, it begins with a desire we allow to grow.
lines.headline: A desire allowed to grow

lines.text: Our choices begin in the heart, and every temptation challenges us to choose wisely.
lines.headline: Choices begin in the heart

lines.text: Don't let temporary desires lead your life.
lines.headline: Desires are temporary

lines.text: Recognize the temptation. Turn toward God. Choose what is right.
James 1:14 reminds us: temptation begins when our own desires draw us away.

verse.text: “But each person is tempted when they are dragged away by their own evil desire and enticed.”
